card.name: Exception words like except and excluding
card.fires_on: Words that introduce an exception or special case, such as except, excluding, and the for or in after a threshold or exception. Seen in dosing, toxicity-grade and threshold statements.

modes.label: Except / excluding
modes.description: The word that opens an exception inside parentheses or after a condition.
modes.example: Hypotension requiring multiple vasopressors (<<excluding>> vasopressin), and/or •

modes.label: Word after a threshold or exception
modes.description: A small word like for, in or used that leads into a specific subgroup or limitation.
modes.example: patients with baseline neutrophil counts of less than 1,500 cells/mm 3 (<1,000 cells/mm 3<< for>> patients with KS).

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the word special, as in a special case or special group.
card.plain: It lights up on words that mark an exception, like except or excluding, in label rules.
